claim_boundary: This gate only counts benchmark-score inflation when a benchmark-specific conversion, split/timing audit, and policy rerun report pass. Source-level metadata gaps do not count as score-inflation evidence.
current_claim_policy: The paper may call famous benchmarks unaudited with respect to WorldEpisode controls, but must not call their scores inflated until this gate has at least one measured inflation claim.

required_tests.evidence: A WorldEpisode manifest/sidecar for the benchmark subset, plus conversion report with loss accounting and source data revision.
required_tests.name: benchmark_specific_worldepisode_conversion

required_tests.evidence: A split or replay audit showing the original protocol leaks world/entity/source lineage or omits timing semantics, and the corrected protocol removes that failure.
required_tests.name: lineage_or_timing_audit

required_tests.evidence: A rerun of a published policy protocol or faithful reproduction, with policy code, configuration, seeds, and evaluation command recorded.
required_tests.name: published_protocol_rerun

required_tests.evidence: The same policy evaluated under the corrected lineage-disjoint split or timestamp-aware replay with the same metric and tolerance envelope.
required_tests.name: paired_corrected_evaluation

required_tests.evidence: A positive baseline-minus-corrected score drop with enough seeds or paired episodes to support the claim being made.
required_tests.name: measured_score_delta

rerun_reports.claim_boundary: Valid rerun evidence can support an inflation claim only for this benchmark, policy, protocol, subset, metric, and seed set.
errors: lineage_source.sufficient_for_score_inflation_claim must be true for split-leakage inflation claims
published_protocol must mark published_leaderboard_reproduction or faithful_published_protocol_reproduction true
baseline_score must be greater than corrected_score for inflation
